target: forge.sh pr-create (gitlab) — project id is the URL-encoded repo path for https (with port, no .git), scp and ssh remotes; ssh base has no port
cmd:
. "$FIXTURES/forge/setup.sh"; fx_init
fx_remote https://gitlab.example.test/o/r.git
export FORGE_TOKEN=glpat-FAKE-not-a-real-token-0001
fx_http "GET /api/v4/projects/g%2Fs%2Fp/merge_requests?source_branch=feat&state=opened" 200 '[]'
fx_http "POST /api/v4/projects/g%2Fs%2Fp/merge_requests" 201 '{"iid":5,"web_url":"https://gitlab.example.test/g/s/p/-/merge_requests/5"}'
rcs=0
for spec in "https-port|https://gitlab.example.test:8443/g/s/p.git" "https-nogit|https://gitlab.example.test/g/s/p" "scp|git@gitlab.example.test:g/s/p.git" "ssh-port|ssh://git@gitlab.example.test:2222/g/s/p.git"; do
  fx_setremote "${spec#*|}"; fx_reqs_clear
  fx_run pr-create --head feat --base main --title T --body-file body.md
  [[ $FX_RC -eq 0 ]] || rcs=$FX_RC
  echo "${spec%%|*} $(grep '^POST ' "$FORGE_MOCK_DIR/requests.log" 2>/dev/null)"
done
echo "all.rc=$rcs"
fx_done
